src/browser-catalog-intent-service.ts.name: Intent availability service
src/browser-catalog-intent-service.ts.description: Connects the installed-napplet catalog to NAP-INTENT so napplets see which intents can be handled, and cleans up with the service.

src/browser-intent-builder-controls.ts.name: Link builder controls
src/browser-intent-builder-controls.ts.description: Creates the form controls of the intent-link builder dialog and keeps option order as the manifest lists it.

src/browser-intent-builder-payload.ts.name: Link builder output
src/browser-intent-builder-payload.ts.description: Builds the intent link from the form and parses it back, so the preview, Copy and Test all use the same checked link.

src/browser-intent-builder-rows.ts.name: Link builder parameter rows
src/browser-intent-builder-rows.ts.description: Adds one parameter row, advertised or custom, to the intent-link builder.

src/browser-intent-builder.ts.name: Intent link builder
src/browser-intent-builder.ts.description: Runs the dialog where a developer composes, previews, copies and tests a shareable intent link for the current napplet.

src/browser-intent-controller.ts.name: Intent target lifecycle
src/browser-intent-controller.ts.description: Opens or focuses the napplet chosen for an intent and queues one delivery to it, tracking when it ends.

src/browser-intent-host.ts.name: Intent host glue
src/browser-intent-host.ts.description: Gives intent dispatch its tab operations, logs each installed napplet's intents, and resolves or rejects waits for a tab to be ready.

src/browser-intent-launcher-host.ts.name: Shared link launch
src/browser-intent-launcher-host.ts.description: Opens shared content through a short-lived, verified launcher frame that hands the link to the right napplet.

src/browser-intent-link-target.ts.name: Shared link app choice
src/browser-intent-link-target.ts.description: Works out which verified napplet a shared link names or the user prefers, under the normal pointer checks.

src/browser-intent-links.ts.name: Shared link controller
src/browser-intent-links.ts.description: Opens shared content straight away, asking the recipient to pick an app only when more than one fits.

src/installed-napplet-catalog.ts.name: Installed napplets catalog
src/installed-napplet-catalog.ts.description: Keeps a saved list of verified napplet installs and their intents, separate from which tabs are open, and notifies listeners of changes.

src/intent-launcher.ts.name: Signed intent launcher
src/intent-launcher.ts.description: Verifies Paja's bundled, signed launcher napplet and sends it a shared-link address only on its own registered frame.

src/intent-link.ts.name: Intent link format
src/intent-link.ts.description: Creates and parses Paja's shareable intent deep links, capped at a configurable size, without running them.
